review.candidate_binding: Direct Git comparison: successful executed source to reviewed clean subject differs only in one CLAUDE.md current-status line; runtime, dictionaries, observer, oracle and drivers are unchanged.
review.independence: Reviewer authored the earlier bounded scope plan, but not translations, observer, oracle, either runner or product fix. No engine was run by this reviewer.

population.source_keys: Baccarat 4 + Roulette 18 = 22 Korean keys; existing accepted CN/TW values = 44. No new translation acceptance.
population.cases_per_locale: 15 prepared prebet captures: 14 normal states covering 21 normal keys, plus one explicit negative-number defensive fixture covering the remaining key.
population.successful_observations: Two locale runs, 30 full PNGs and 188 raw synthetic input events (94 per locale). These are one shared successful population for ORDER-292 and ORDER-293, not 60 PNGs or four successful runs.
population.original_failure_population: Two original runs each produced 15 PNGs and 94 raw events, with one failing state per locale; neither original run is relabeled PASS.
population.direct_image_review: All 30 successful full-resolution PNGs individually viewed; original CN and TW failing number-36 Xbox PNGs individually viewed. The other 28 original PNGs were hash-verified, not visually reviewed.

method: Read authority, active unit specifications, frozen plan, current table/input/font/bootstrap code, complete oracle and observer, and both complete runners.
Independently checked all structured state rows and the full ordered 94-event common sequence; verified CN/TW successful mutable transitions and same-locale pre/post-fix event streams are identical.
Recomputed hashes for all four results, observations, raw logs and all 60 generated PNGs; result hashes bind the complete image lists and source/user manifests without duplicating them here.
Verified each run's source-before/source-after and user-before/user-after maps, cross-run original-user equality, current original-user hashes, and final source/runtime binding.
Compared each successful full PNG with expected Chinese fragments, amounts, highlighted choices, input glyphs, warnings, text bounds and parent clipping; inspected the two original failing full PNGs.

verified.run_outcomes: Original CN and TW each exit 1 with 14 state PASS/1 FAIL and one unique visible-clipping assertion. Successful CN and TW each exit 0, pass true, 15 captures, 94 raw events, errors empty and the exact completion marker. Original repeated log copies are not additional defects.
verified.runner_integrity: Frozen 293 runner adds a strict exact-original-Roulette/sole-separation-replacement guard and 293 pins; observation, replay and geometry validators remain unchanged. Assertion/error, marker, ordered ID/count, raw stream, exit and state/hash guards remain active.
verified.cash_and_pending: Baccarat staged 10,000 + 50,000 + 100,000 + 500,000 + 1,000,000 = 1,660,000 won; displayed 166万/萬 and cash 1000万/萬 remain consistent. Pending placement does not debit the prepared 10,000,000 wallet. Roulette stake replacement and outside bets match the independent oracle.
verified.input_routes: Keyboard prebet/action/mode navigation, five Baccarat buckets, seven Roulette outside routes, number 0→36→0→36, forced Xbox glyphs and semantic accept, trigger held/release behavior, and clear-then-exit are observed. The defensive negative number is prepared explicitly, not claimed reachable by ordinary navigation.
verified.trigger_samples: Actual samples are 0.56 press, 0.90 held, 0.40 still held and 0.34 release; exact 0.55/0.35 equality boundaries were not tested.
verified.protected_state: Cash/AP, serialized state, meta/settings and namespace files match their prepared baseline across events; no deal, spin or settlement executes. Original 43 user files are unchanged before/after all four runs, equal across runs, and independently rehashed unchanged at review.
verified.source_pins: Original runs each pin 1235 source inputs; successful runs each pin 1237. Current successful-pin comparison differs only in the documented CLAUDE.md status line. Original-to-success shared-pin differences are the declared Roulette line and ORDER-292 specification; added inputs are the 293 driver/specification.
verified.layout_and_fonts: At 1280×800, actual SC/TC fonts render reviewed node and canvas text without in-scope tofu, clipping or overlap. Roulette draw_string labels at font size 28 measure 56–150 pixels within the 218-pixel budget; source-relative parent/vertical bounds also pass.
verified.input_and_teardown_limits: GUI focus remains empty: evidence exercises the game's semantic navigation, not focus-rescue or a physical controller. Successful teardown reports no remaining table instance and clears the forced input override.
verified.failure_repair: Original number-36 Xbox balance rect y=776,h=22 extended below scroller bottom y=790. After the sole spacing fix it is y=754,h=22, bottom=776, with 14 pixels clearance in both locales. Explicitly scrollable content need not universally fit; this exposed partial cash label in the tested semantic-pad state was a real bounded visual defect.

findings_and_repairs: One localized layout deficiency reproduced in both regions; separate ORDER-293 repair changes Roulette VBox separation from 6 to 4 only. No dictionary, money, phase, route, settlement, font or validator relaxation was used.
Frozen same-locale event/state expectations and actual text remain identical before/after; full successful 30-frame review found no additional mandatory issue within the declared population.

The closure-selection dispatch note is an honest summary, not a raw transcript or pass certificate: accidental 26-check dispatch completed six static checks, then was interrupted during ZH self-test (exit 130). Remaining checks have no result. This review does not infer 26 PASS, a full audit, or extra runtime coverage.
unobserved: Normal player ingress/tutorial/save progression, real mouse/gamepad hardware, other controller brands, other resolutions and normal-speed usability.
Any dealt/spun/completed round, settlement, outcome/RNG/history correctness, completed-session closed/meta idempotence, or exact trigger equality boundaries.
Arbitrary money precision or changes to existing localized money formatting.
Excluded English parent/table-face/bet-button families; this is not a whole-casino or full-localization GO.
Audio (runs use Dummy audio), packaging, full-game/release approval and future closure metadata/gates.
The interrupted audit dispatch itself was not independently observed; only its preserved limitation note was read.
approved_scope: Prepared CN/TW actual-display and synthetic semantic-input regression for the declared 22-key pending-bet/navigation surface, after the separately declared ORDER-293 repair; scoped work-unit GO only.
decision: The initial failures remain preserved. The unchanged observer/oracle and strict follow-up runner now demonstrate the bounded 30-frame/188-event acceptance population at the reviewed runtime-identical clean source.
